'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a reoccurring NPC in the daily quest; In the Name of Chivalry. He's a Resonator training to become a true knight and is being mentored by Rover. 

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(After completing [[In the Name of Chivalry VI]])
:'''Faro:''' Knight stories, traditional cuisines, and Night Reveries... My hometown is rich with these relics of the past.
:'''Faro:''' No wonder so many kids there dream of becoming knights.
:{{DIcon}} You seem to be the one who has ventured the farthest.
:'''Faro:''' That's because I have the best mentor.
:{{DIcon}} Stop, you're making me embarrassed.
::'''Faro:''' Hahaha, knights never lie.
:{{DIcon}} Just don't mention my name when you mess up!
::'''Faro:''' I promise, I won't let you down.
{{Dialogue End}}
